decks.common-default-rails/sine:
* quiz circuit
* issue: unconnected_port in+
* issue: unconnected_port out+
Vin in 0 SIN(5e-1 1e+0 1e+3)
Rload out outl 1e+12
Vmeas outl 0 0
.tran 1e-5 5e-3 0
.control
set wr_vecnames
set wr_singlescale
run
linearize v(in) v(out) i(Vmeas)
wrdata /dev/stdout v(in) v(out) i(Vmeas)
.endc
.end

decks.split-dual-rails/step:
* quiz circuit
* issue: unconnected_port in+
* issue: unconnected_port in-
* issue: unconnected_port out+
* issue: unconnected_port out-
* issue: no_ground
Vcc vcc 0 DC 1.5e+1
Vee vee 0 DC -1.5e+1
Vin src inn PWL(0 0 1e-3 0 1.000001e-3 5e+0)
Rs src in 5e+1
Rload out outl 1e+4
Vmeas outl outn 0
.tran 4.5e-5 1e-2 1e-3
.control
set wr_vecnames
set wr_singlescale
run
linearize v(in) v(out) i(Vmeas)
wrdata /dev/stdout v(in) v(out) i(Vmeas)
.endc
.end
